Call Manish first to discuss his unlocked SEDEMAC shares and whether he wants to retain them or plan around them. His holding is shown as ₹110.73 Cr. He could also have received up to ₹6.08 crore from the offer for sale, if all offered shares were sold; confirm the sale and proceeds with him.

Priyanka Manish Sharma is shown with ₹7.71 Cr. The household match is unsure because the link was inferred from the printed names; confirm their relationship with Manish before treating it as household money.
